style: Cinematic 3D animated short film, simple clean geometry, soft morning light, consistent materials and proportions. No text, no subtitles.
character: One small friendly robot with a light gray body, dark blue joints and trim, exactly two arms and two legs. Its round rectangular head has exactly three circular cyan camera lenses arranged as a triangle: two lenses on top and one centered below. There is no mouth. Full body, front three-quarter view against a plain neutral backdrop. Empty hands.
location: An empty small workshop. A wooden table is on the right side of the room. Exactly one small matte red cube rests on this table. One unlit amber glass light bulb stands on a separate waist-high pedestal with an empty square cube-sized socket in its base. The bulb is switched off, dark glass with no glowing filament and no emitted light. A wooden door is in the back wall. One window is on the left wall. Soft morning daylight from the window. No people, no robots, no other lamps, no other cubes.
